¡Bienvenidos! Looking for Spanish Answering Services?

We are proud to offer bilingual Spanish answering services to the growing number of businesses serving the Hispanic market, a unique market segment that is enjoying unprecedented and explosive growth. If you’re currently not reaching this market, we can help with our bilingual call center and Spanish language call support solutions.

Bilingual Answering Services

Whatever your business, whether as a doctor, dentist, lawyer, realtor, plumbing contractor or as an infomercial producer facing demanding 24/7 phone order taking loads, our goal is to be your bilingual resource of choice. We have a professional Hispanic services staff trained to meet your multilingual Spanish-speaking call center needs.

Peace of Mind

Our Spanish-speaking call center agents will handle your incoming calls and provide translation and interpretation services. We employ the best customer service practices to handle the increased call center volumes in this market. Because we want you to get the most from your call center investment, we place a high priority on integrating the call center into a customer relationship. We understand that managing customer relationships is crucial to your success in building lifetime relationships with your customers.

Cost-Effective Solutions Offered By Our Spanish Call Centers

For a fraction of the cost, you can have the presence of a highly trained, professional bilingual virtual staff around the clock. There is no need to hire, fire, give performance appraisals, train, cover for vacations, pay wages and employer taxes or to lease expensive office space. Because we specialize in providing our services to a number of businesses, we can charge each only a fraction of the normal expense incurred by hiring a full-time staff. You’ll get better services for less money and without the time-consuming responsibility of managing a staff.

Our Spanish services include:

  • Call Center Services
  • Virtual Receptionist Services
  • Attorney Answering Services
  • Traditional Answering Services

If you are missing calls, stretching your staff thin, and not getting the right people answering your phones with the proper training, do not worry! Let Alert handle all of these details so you can get back to focusing on helping your new clients. To get started, fill out our contact form or give us a call at
844-236-2485.
